Lines 39-48: the rotation identity and the A_g identity are asserted for every pair (s,t) of independently chosen points of the two punctured sides (the germ's image), rather than for chamber values; under chamber-constancy of rot and A_g this is equivalent to the source, and it does not rely on that constancy.

After a clause-by-clause comparison of `SM.WallGerm.cusp_law_treeCoefficient` (work/reviews/thm-A-S4-reviewer-input-statement.lean.txt) with thm:A-S4 (sm-2-amplitude.tex:460-470) and def:walls (K) (sm-1-polygons.tex:737-775), I found no place where the Lean statement is weaker than, adds a hypothesis to, quantifies differently from, or mis-signs the printed theorem.

(a) Hypotheses. `CuspAt` (CuspDefinition.lean) is `4 ≤ n ∧ pointZeros = {turnSupport j} ∧ concurrences = ∅ ∧ ¬∃ t∈[0,1], μ_j = μ_{j-1} + t(μ_{j+1}-μ_{j-1}) ∧ SignChanges (turn · j)`, instantiated at n+1 vertices. `pointZeros`/`concurrences` (GermDefinition.lean → ZeroTriples.lean) are Z_pt (card-3 sets with χ=0) and Z_c (card-3 pairwise-remote sets with a common point in three edge interiors) verbatim; `turnSupport j = {j-1,j,j+1}`; `turn P j = chi P (j-1) j (j+1)` = τ_j; `SignChanges` (GermSignChange.lean) is ∃δ>0, φ(P(t))φ(P(−t))<0 for 0<t<δ. Collinearity is implied by χ=0 in both. `hQ : G1 (deleteVertex w.center j)` = "Q=P(0)∖j satisfies (G1)". Nothing added, nothing dropped.

(b) Sides and newborn pair, checked with coordinates. Placement μ_{j-1}=(0,0), μ_{j+1}=(1,0), μ_j=(2,0): source says μ_{j+1} lies between μ_{j-1} and μ_j, newborn {j-1,j+1}; Lean `CuspCase P j true = StrictBetween (P (j-1)) (P (j+1)) (P j)` holds with t=1/2, `CuspCase false` fails (t=2), and `cuspFirst true j = j-1`, `cuspLast true j = j+1`. Placement μ_j=(0,0), μ_{j-1}=(1,0), μ_{j+1}=(2,0): source says μ_{j-1} between μ_j and μ_{j+1}, newborn {j-2,j}; Lean `CuspCase false = StrictBetween (P j) (P (j-1)) (P (j+1))` holds with t=1/2, `CuspCase true` fails (t=−1), and `cuspFirst false j = j-2`, `cuspLast false j = j`. `cuspLoopSide b j` (CuspSideCrossings.lean) is `true` iff the newborn pair `IsCrossing` on the positive side at `sideBase`; the theorem itself asserts `∀ s, IsCrossing (loop side) ∧ ¬IsCrossing (other side)`, which is exactly the printed "the side on which the newborn pair is a crossing" made into a conclusion, so no mis-naming is possible without making the statement false. `IsCrossing` (Crossings.lean) = remote pair with nonempty intersection of closed edge segments = def:crossings. Not vacuous: `b` is fixed by the asserted case uniqueness.

(c) κ. Lean: `∃ κ : ℤ, (κ = -1 ∨ κ = 1) ∧ ∀ s t, rotationNumber(loop s) − rotationNumber(no-loop t) = (κ:ℝ)`; source: κ = rot(P_loop) − rot(P_no) ∈ {−1,1}. Same order and sign. `rotationNumber P = (∑ principalTurn P i)/(2π)`, `principalTurn P i = arg(conj(ℓ_{i-1})·ℓ_i)` whose re/im are ⟨ℓ_{i-1},ℓ_i⟩ and det(ℓ_{i-1},ℓ_i), i.e. the printed ϑ_i of def:regular; side tuples are generic ⇒ G1 ⇒ Regular so this is lem:rot's rot.

(d) The law. Lean: `treeCoefficient (loop s) g − treeCoefficient (no-loop t) g = -κ * treeCoefficient Q hQ (deletionRoot j g)` for every root g : ZMod (n+1); source: A_g(P_loop) − A_g(P_no) = −κ A_{D_j(g)}(Q). Same order of subtraction, same sign, same root map.

(e) Primitives. `treeCoefficient` (TreeCoefficient.lean, Gates.lean, RootBoundary.lean) reproduces def:root/gates/treesum: boundary word a_k = μ_{g+k+1}, near sign χ(a_{r_{k+1}},a_{r_k},a_{r_{k-1}}), far sign χ(a_j,a_{r_k},a_i), gates d·Θ(∓hd) with Θ(1)=1, Θ(−1)=0 (sm-1-polygons.tex:8-9), open sums b=1 on one leaf and −∑_{|π|≥2} V^+∏b otherwise, A_g = ∑_π V^−∏b over [0,N]. `deleteVertex P j i = P((i.val : ZMod (n+1)) + j + 1)` enumerates μ_{j+1},…,μ_{j-1} with fused edge −1 = μ_{j+1} − μ_{j-1}; `deletionRoot j g = fusionIndex j g` sends g∈{j-1,j} to −1 and other g to the edge with the same endpoints (def:induced-roots).

Where the Lean is stronger (never weaker): it additionally asserts uniqueness of the cusp case, the crossing status at every point of both sides, and the rot difference and the law for every pair of side points rather than for chamber values.

refuters.argument:
After a clause-by-clause comparison of `SM.WallGerm.cusp_law_treeCoefficient` (work/reviews/thm-A-S4-reviewer-input-statement.lean.txt) against thm:A-S4 (reference/SM/sm-2-amplitude.tex:460-470) and the definitions it invokes, I found no place where the Lean statement is weaker than, adds a hypothesis to, quantifies differently from, or changes a sign, root or polygon of the printed statement. Details of what I checked:

(a) HYPOTHESES. Source: "At a simple cusp wall at j with n ≥ 4 whose deletion Q = P(0)∖j satisfies (G1)". Lean: `(w : WallGerm (n + 1)) (j : ZMod (n + 1)) (hf : w.CuspAt j) (hQ : G1 (deleteVertex w.center j))`. `WallGerm` (WallGerm.lean:13-19) is exactly def:germ: continuous curve on (−radius, radius), `Generic` for t ≠ 0, `¬ Generic` at 0. `CuspAt` (CuspDefinition.lean:41-45) is `4 ≤ n ∧ g.pointZeros = {turnSupport j} ∧ g.concurrences = ∅ ∧ (¬ ∃ t, 0 ≤ t ∧ t ≤ 1 ∧ g.center j = g.center (j-1) + t • (g.center (j+1) - g.center (j-1))) ∧ g.SignChanges (fun P => (turn P j : ℝ))`, instantiated at n+1, i.e. n+1 ≥ 4 vertices. Word by word against def:walls (K) (sm-1-polygons.tex:744-755): "Z_pt = {{j−1,j,j+1}}" = `pointZeros = {turnSupport j}` with `turnSupport i = {i-1, i, i+1}` (TurnSupports.lean:10) and `pointZeros = pointZeroTriples g.center` (GermDefinition.lean:12, located by grep; `PointZeroTriple P s := s.card = 3 ∧ ∀ i j k ∈ s, chi P i j k = 0`, ZeroTriples.lean:13-14, equivalent to χ_ijk = 0 for one ordering by `pointZeroTriple_iff`); "Z_c = ∅" = `concurrences = ∅` with `concurrences = concurrenceTriples g.center` (GermDefinition.lean:14) and `ConcurrenceTriple P s := s.card = 3 ∧ s.Pairwise remote ∧ ∃ x, ∀ i ∈ s, x ∈ edgeInterior P i` (ZeroTriples.lean:61-63) = pairwise remote triple with a common relative-interior point; "μ_j(0) outside the closed segment [μ_{j−1}(0), μ_{j+1}(0)]" = the negated ∃ t ∈ [0,1] clause (exactly the closed segment, both endpoints included); "the three points are collinear" is implied by Z_pt containing {j−1,j,j+1} (χ_{j−1,j,j+1}=0), so it is neither dropped nor added; "τ_j changes sign at 0" = `SignChanges (turn · j)` where `SignChanges φ := ∃ δ, 0 < δ ∧ δ ≤ radius ∧ ∀ t : SideParameter, t < δ → φ(P(t)) * φ(P(−t)) < 0` (GermSignChange.lean:10-12), matching def:germ "there is δ>0 with φ(P(t))φ(P(−t))<0 for 0<t<δ" (the extra `δ ≤ radius` is shown equivalent by `signChanges_iff_local`). `G1 P := ∀ i j k, i ≠ j → j ≠ k → i ≠ k → chi P i j k ≠ 0` (Generic.lean:11-12) is (G1) verbatim, and `chi P i j k = sign det(P j − P i, P k − P i)` (Chirotope.lean:10-11) is def:chirotope. The only extra argument is the instance `[NeZero n]`, which is implied by `hf.1 : 4 ≤ n + 1`; no hypothesis of substance is added and none is dropped.

(b) Q = P(0)∖j AND VERTEX ORDER. `w.center = w.curve 0` (WallGerm.lean:30) is P(0). `deleteVertex P j i = P (deletionIndex j i)` (DeletedTuple.lean:13-14) with the kernel-checked lemmas `deletionIndex j 0 = j+1`, `deletionIndex j (-1) = j-1`, `deletionIndex j (i+1) = deletionIndex j i + 1` for i ≠ −1 (DeletionIndices.lean:36-50), so Q = (μ_{j+1}, μ_{j+2}, …, μ_{j−1}): the n-tuple omitting μ_j in the induced cyclic order, exactly def:deletion-halves (sm-1-polygons.tex:1255-1256). Hand example n+1 = 5, j = 2, kernel-checked by `decide`: Q = (μ3, μ4, μ0, μ1).

(c) D_j(g). `deletionRoot j g = fusionIndex j g = if g = j then -1 else ((g − (j+1)).val : ZMod n)` (InducedRootsDefinition.lean:25, FusionIndices.lean:10-11). Hand example n+1 = 5, j = 2, kernel-checked: D_2(0)=2, D_2(1)=3=−1, D_2(2)=3=−1, D_2(3)=0, D_2(4)=1. Incident g ∈ {1,2} = {j−1, j}: both give −1, and `edge (deleteVertex P j) (-1) = P (j+1) − P (j−1)` (DeletedTuple.lean:32-34), the fused edge from μ_{j−1} to μ_{j+1} — the source's "the fused edge [μ_{j−1}, μ_{j+1}] of P∖j, g ∈ {j−1, j}" (sm-2-amplitude.tex:388). Non-incident g ∈ {0,3,4}: Q-edge 2 = [μ0,μ1] = E_0, Q-edge 0 = [μ3,μ4] = E_3, Q-edge 1 = [μ4,μ0] = E_4 — "the edge of P∖j with the same endpoints as E_g" (line 389); the general statement `deletionIndex j (deletionRoot j g) = g ∧ deletionIndex j (deletionRoot j g + 1) = g + 1` for non-incident g is `DeletionRootData.nonincident_case` (InducedRootsDefinition.lean:42-49), proved for all n, j by `deletionRoot_data`, and was also kernel-checked for the 5-gon by `decide`.

(d) SIDES AND NEWBORN PAIR. `CuspCase P j true = StrictBetween (P (j−1)) (P (j+1)) (P j)` = "μ_{j+1}(0) lies between μ_{j−1}(0) and μ_j(0)" with `cuspFirst true j = j−1, cuspLast true j = j+1` (newborn pair {j−1, j+1}); `CuspCase P j false = StrictBetween (P j) (P (j−1)) (P (j+1))` = "μ_{j−1}(0) lies between μ_j(0) and μ_{j+1}(0)" with `cuspFirst false j = j−2, cuspLast false j = j−2+2 = j` (newborn pair {j−2, j}) (CuspDefinition.lean:12-18; `StrictBetween a x b := a ≠ b ∧ ∃ t, 0 < t ∧ t < 1 ∧ x = a + t•(b−a)`, StrictBetween.lean:9-10). Both match def:walls (K) lines 748-751 (strictness is automatic since Z_pt is a singleton, so vertices are distinct). `IsCrossing P s := ∃ i j, s = {i,j} ∧ remote i j ∧ (edgeSegment P i ∩ edgeSegment P j).Nonempty` (Crossings.lean:12-13) is def:crossings X(P) ("unordered pairs {i,j} of remote edge indices with E_i ∩ E_j ≠ ∅"), with `remote = ¬adjacent`, `adjacent i j := j−i ∈ {−1,0,1}` (Polygon.lean:63-66). The theorem's third conjunct asserts the newborn pair IS a crossing at every point of `w.cuspLoopSide b j` and is NOT a crossing at every point of `!(w.cuspLoopSide b j)`, which pins `cuspLoopSide b j` to "the side on which the newborn pair is a crossing" = P_loop and its negation to P_no (line 752-753), independently of how `cuspLoopSide` is defined (CuspSideCrossings.lean:49-52 defines it from the positive base point). `sideTuple positive t = curve(±t)` for t ∈ (0, radius) (WallGerm.lean:34-50) covers exactly the germ's two punctured sides P((0,ε)), P((−ε,0)) of def:germ. Nothing is vacuous: the conjunct is a definite claim that would be false, not vacuous, if both or neither side carried the crossing.

(e) κ. `rotationNumber P = (∑ i, principalTurn P i) / (2π)` (RotationNumber.lean:10-11) with `principalTurn P i = principalAngle (edge P (i−1)) (edge P i)` satisfying `PrincipalAngleSpec`: θ ∈ (−π,π), cos θ = ⟨ℓ_{i−1},ℓ_i⟩/(|ℓ_{i−1}||ℓ_i|), sign θ = sign det(ℓ_{i−1},ℓ_i) (PrincipalAngles.lean:9-16, RegularLocus.lean:15-16), i.e. def:regular's ϑ_i and lem:rot's rot. Lean: `∃ κ : ℤ, (κ = -1 ∨ κ = 1) ∧ ∀ s t, rotationNumber(loop side at s) − rotationNumber(no-loop side at t) = (κ : ℝ)` = "κ = rot(P_loop) − rot(P_no) ∈ {−1,1}", same order (loop minus no), integer κ.

(f) THE IDENTITY. Lean: `treeCoefficient (loop side at s) _ g _ − treeCoefficient (no-loop side at t) _ g _ = -κ * treeCoefficient (deleteVertex w.center j) hQ (deletionRoot j g) _` for every root `g : ZMod (n+1)` and all side points s, t. Source: A_g(P_loop) − A_g(P_no) = −κ A_{D_j(g)}(Q) for every root g. Same difference order, same sign −κ, same root D_j(g), same polygon Q = P(0)∖j. `treeCoefficient P hP g hn = rootedTreeRec (ordinaryWeight) (rootWeight) (fullBoundaryInterval hn)` (TreeCoefficient.lean:51-53) expands to def:treesum: boundary word `boundaryIndex g k = g + k + 1` (a_k = μ_{g+k+1}, RootBoundary.lean:8-9), intervals [i,j] with 0 ≤ i < j ≤ n−1 (`BoundaryInterval`), compositions as strictly increasing cut sequences (`IntervalComposition`, RootBoundary.lean:62-68), near sign `chi P a_{r_{k+1}} a_{r_k} a_{r_{k−1}}` and far sign `chi P a_j a_{r_k} a_i` (Gates.lean:35-43 = def:gates d_k, h_k), gates `d * Θ(−h d)` / `d * Θ(h d)` with Θ(1)=1, Θ(−1)=0 (`signTheta`, Gates.lean:12-22), open recursion `if leaves = 1 then 1 else −∑_{parts ≥ 2} V⁺ ∏ b_parts` (TreeCoefficient.lean:15-21) and rooted sum over all compositions of [0, n−1] including the one-part one (lines 24-27). All of this is representative-independent (`treeCoefficient_shift`, TreeCoefficient.lean:141-149), so the Lean labelling of Q (starting at μ_{j+1}) cannot change A_{D_j(g)}(Q).

STRONGER-THAN-SOURCE (none weaken the claim): the uniqueness conjunct `∀ b', CuspCase w.center j b' → b' = b`; the crossing/no-crossing assertion at every point of each side; and the κ and A_g identities asserted at every pair of side points (s, t) rather than as single chamber values — since the source's F(P_±) is by definition the chamber constant, these are the same numbers. WEAKER-THAN-SOURCE: none found. The only cosmetic deviation is that the brief's file list places `pointZeros`/`concurrences` in WallCenterClassification.lean; they are one-line definitions in GermDefinition.lean:12,14, which I read via grep only.

Lean (statement file): `(hf : w.CuspAt j) (hQ : G1 (deleteVertex w.center j))` ... `∃ κ : ℤ, (κ = -1 ∨ κ = 1) ∧ ∀ s t, (rotationNumber (loop s) - rotationNumber (no t) = (κ : ℝ)) ∧ ∀ g, treeCoefficient (loop s) _ g _ - treeCoefficient (no t) _ g _ = -κ * treeCoefficient (deleteVertex w.center j) hQ (deletionRoot j g) _`.

def:walls (K) (sm-1-polygons.tex:744-747): "Cusp at $j$ ($n\geq4$): $Z_{\rm pt}=\{\{j-1,j,j+1\}\}$, $Z_{\rm c}=\varnothing$, the three points ... are collinear with $\mu_j(0)$ outside the closed segment $[\mu_{j-1}(0),\mu_{j+1}(0)]$, and $\tau_j$ changes sign at $0$." def:germ sign change (sm-1-polygons.tex:695-696): "changes sign at $0$ if there is $\delta>0$ with $\phi(P(t))\phi(P(-t))<0$ for $0<t<\delta$."  Lean GermSignChange.lean:10-12: `∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ δ ≤ g.radius ∧ ∀ t : g.SideParameter, t.val < δ → φ (g.sideTuple true t).val * φ (g.sideTuple false t).val < 0`, with `sideTuple true t = curve t`, `sideTuple false t = curve (−t)` (WallGerm.lean:34-50).

def:walls (K) newborn pair (sm-1-polygons.tex:748-751): "$\{j-1,j+1\}$ if $\mu_{j+1}(0)$ lies between $\mu_{j-1}(0)$ and $\mu_j(0)$, and $\{j-2,j\}$ if $\mu_{j-1}(0)$ lies between $\mu_j(0)$ and $\mu_{j+1}(0)$."  Lean CuspDefinition.lean:12-18: `CuspCase P j true = StrictBetween (P (j - 1)) (P (j + 1)) (P j)`, `false = StrictBetween (P j) (P (j - 1)) (P (j + 1))`; `cuspFirst true j = j - 1`, `cuspLast = cuspFirst + 2`; `cuspFirst false j = j - 2`. Kernel-checked for ZMod 5, j=2: pairs {1,3} and {0,2}.

def:walls (K) sides (sm-1-polygons.tex:751-753): "The loop side $P_{\rm loop}$ is the side on which the newborn pair is a crossing and the no-loop side $P_{\rm no}$ the other."
